rationale: Supported by the N-terminal segment being membrane-insertion competent (dG19 -2.61, 0.4th percentile of 738 verified human signal peptides) with no second anchor anywhere in the chain. Safe fallback if the ER assignment is judged unsupported.

go_term: integral component of endoplasmic reticulum membrane
recommended_action: add as a lead, do not assert
rationale: More informative than GO:0016021 and matches the characterised paralogs. The ER compartment itself is inferred from AADAC and NCEH1, not measured for AADACL4; AADACL4 has no localization experiment and 1.7 nTPM maximum expression.
Use only if the curator prefers the compartment term over the integral-component term. Same inference chain and same caveat.

rationale: Would follow only from the cleaved-signal-peptide reading. rationale: No cleaved signal peptide should be annotated. The same applies as a separate lead to AADACL2 (Q6P093), which carries both determinants mapped experimentally in AADAC (Lys4, Asp25) yet is annotated with a cleaved signal peptide 1-18 (ECO:0000255).
